title: One path for every trap
subtitle: The frame goes on the interrupted thread's own stack. Click a stage for details.

steps.name: trap
steps.role: An exception or interrupt taken in S-mode

steps.name: kernelvec
details: Pushes a 304-byte frame on the current stack, x1 to x31, sepc, sstatus, scause and stval
Adds a fake frame record so backtraces cross the trap

outputs.via: sp within one frame of the stack bottom
outputs.name: emergency stack
outputs.role: Report the overflow and exit with code 3

cases.then: Rearm, ticks++, wake sleepers, then maybe yield()

steps.name: back in kernelvec
steps.role: Interrupts off, restore sepc, sstatus and the registers, then sret
